categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and fixes request parsing and connection handling in the node's internal HTTP server.
categories.rationale: Fixes a regression from #35182 that executes pipelined HTTP requests after a connection-closing reply. The PR description notes that RFC 9112 requires discarding such requests, whereas currently 'requests pipelined behind conflicting framing requests [are] executed unexpectedly instead of discarded', creating HTTP request-framing and security risks.
